k1_length_gate.description: Reject the distal endpoint of a bone whose observed length is outside the calibrated tolerance.

k2_soft_projection.description: Unprotected soft projection retained as an ablation.

k2_guarded_projection.description: Soft projection only when the complete two-bone limb chain is inside the calibrated length gate.

design_restrictions: Do not use held-out GT to select these parameters.
Do not change raw validity in K2 or K2g.
Do not recover an unobserved joint.
Do not apply a bone whose profile constraint_enabled flag is false.
Do not project any part of a two-bone chain containing an out-of-domain bone in K2g.
Cap total per-frame displacement from the raw joint position.
